mapper.sql: FROM ops_user_role ur JOIN ops_role r ON r.code=ur.role_code JOIN identity_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND r.enabled=TRUE AND ur.status='ACTIVE' AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > )
mapper.select: SELECT id,status,password_hash,operations_version FROM identity_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM ops_user_role ur JOIN ops_role r ON r.code=ur.role_code JOIN ops_role_permission p ON p.role_code=r.code JOIN identity_user u ON u.id=ur.user_id WHERE ur.user_id=#{userId} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND r.enabled=TRUE AND ur.status='ACTIVE' AND (ur.expires_at IS NULL OR ur.expires_at > ) ORDER BY p.permission_code
SELECT id FROM identity_user WHERE id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ops_confirmation_rate WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND window_started_at > DATE_SUB(,INTERVAL 1 MINUTE) AND attempts >= 5
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ops_confirmation_rate(user_id,window_started_at,attempts) VALUES(#{userId},,1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE attempts=IF(window_started_at <= DATE_SUB(,INTERVAL 1 MINUTE),1,attempts+1), window_started_at=IF(window_started_at <= DATE_SUB(,INTERVAL 1 MINUTE), ,window_started_at)
mapper.select: SELECT token_hash,user_id,session_hash,command_hash,authority_version,credential_fingerprint,expires_at FROM ops_replay_confirmation WHERE token_hash=#{tokenHash} AND expires_at >
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM ops_replay_confirmation WHERE expires_at <= ORDER BY expires_at, token_hash LIMIT #{limit}
